justification.dataset: DANDI 000986 is a canonical mouse auditory-cortex pure-tone dataset (on the known-good list) and session_description confirms auditory cortex, so the phenomenon is squarely present.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed via remfile, trials aligned to tone onset with evoked/baseline windows validated against the population PSTH, and functional responsiveness/tuning criteria applied.
justification.analysis: The completed single-session analysis uses a correct permutation ANOVA null with BH-FDR and paired responsiveness tests, which is the right treatment for frequency tuning.
justification.correctness: The numbers actually shown (235 units, F/p per example unit, ses-1 yields) reproduce from committed code and are physically plausible, but the multi-session pipeline never completed and the decoder ran with LDA matmul overflow warnings.
justification.figures: fig02/fig03 clearly show the effect with labeled axes, units, and sample sizes, and example units are chosen by tuning strength (ANOVA F) rather than a flattering criterion.
justification.honesty: No scientific result is overstated and the figures honestly represent well-tuned cells, but the README is an empty template with a false claim that numbers are filled in, so there is no proper write-up naming limitations.
